name: What are popular home renovation trends in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: What are popular home renovation trends in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Southern California, current home renovation trends often emphasize open-concept living spaces, indoor-outdoor flow to maximize natural light and views, and sustainable, energy-efficient materials. Popular design aesthetics include modern farmhouse, minimalist contemporary, and Mediterranean-inspired styles that blend seamlessly with the regional climate and lifestyle. Smart home technology integration, spa-like bathrooms, and gourmet kitchens with large islands also remain highly sought-after features, reflecting a desire for both functionality and luxury.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular Southern California renovation trends include open-concept living, indoor-outdoor flow, sustainable materials, and styles like modern farmhouse or minimalist contemporary. Smart home tech and luxurious kitchens/bathrooms are also popular.
